capabilities.name: ASK_USER
capabilities.purpose: Request a user clarification that is necessary or useful to proceed safely.
capabilities.inputSchema: question, optional relatedFields
capabilities.resultMeaning: The task waits for a new user message; no state constraint is changed.
importantConstraints: Do not claim a booking or availability result.

capabilities.name: SEARCH_RESTAURANTS
capabilities.purpose: Discover matching restaurant outlets.
capabilities.inputSchema: optional retrievalHint; the router binds authoritative intent
capabilities.resultMeaning: Returns RestaurantCandidate records only, without availability claims.
importantConstraints: Cannot modify, repeat, or loosen authoritative user constraints.

capabilities.name: INVESTIGATE_CANDIDATE_FACTS
capabilities.purpose: Read source-supported restaurant facts needed by the current request for known candidates.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateIds; the router binds candidates and authoritative request conditions
capabilities.resultMeaning: Returns candidate-associated source facts or an explicit unknown result; it never asserts availability.
importantConstraints: Only known candidates are valid; at most three candidates per bounded read; it does not itself claim a slot.

capabilities.name: CHECK_AVAILABILITY
capabilities.purpose: Read request-bound availability and any source-supported restaurant facts returned with it.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateIds; the router binds authoritative date, time window, and party size
capabilities.resultMeaning: Returns fresh AvailabilityOffer records associated with candidate IDs.
importantConstraints: Only known candidates are valid; schedule values are never Agent-supplied; at most three unchecked candidates per read batch.

capabilities.name: END_READ
capabilities.purpose: End a bounded read-only investigation when its recorded scope has no grounded result to present.
capabilities.inputSchema: no business fields; optional short decision summary is trajectory-only
capabilities.resultMeaning: Writes a scoped NO_VERIFIED_RESULT outcome from authoritative investigation records, never a global negative claim.
importantConstraints: Only code may allow this after actual investigation; it cannot hide an internal failure, pending refresh, or grounded candidate.

capabilities.name: PRESENT_RESULTS
capabilities.purpose: Pause a read-only selection session with candidates whose required facts and availability are grounded.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateIds; validator derives the required evidence from authoritative State
capabilities.resultMeaning: Writes an evidence-grounded result batch and waits for explicit user continuation; it does not select, authorize, or submit a booking.
importantConstraints: Every task-critical fact, including each HARD criterion and availability, must have current trusted evidence.

capabilities.name: SELECT_CANDIDATE
capabilities.purpose: Choose a discovered candidate and optionally its known offer for a possible booking proposal.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateId, optional offerId
capabilities.resultMeaning: Records the selection; it does not authorize or submit a booking.
importantConstraints: A selected offer must belong to the selected candidate.

capabilities.name: BOOK_RESERVATION
capabilities.purpose: Request a booking proposal for one selected fresh offer.
capabilities.inputSchema: candidateId, offerId

Only Lunch Nigiri Gozen13 items

Indulge in our lunch-exclusive Omakase sushi course, featuring the day's recommended ingredients. This carefully crafted menu showcases the artisan's meticulous skill in sushi, complemented by a balanced selection of rolls, warm dishes, tamagoyaki, and soup. It's a satisfying yet accessible experience, making it perfect for first-time visitors. Enjoy a luxurious midday moment at Sushi Ginza!

ReserveSet menu details
JPY 6,000JPY4,999（Price including tax）per person

Omakase Nigiri Course18 items

Our standard omakase course is available for both lunch and dinner. It begins with seasonal appetizers, followed by eight carefully crafted sushi pieces, rice bowls, rolls, and soup, all designed to enhance your dining experience. We strive to provide satisfaction that exceeds the price, with a focus on each individual dish. This course is also recommended for meals with friends or small gatherings.

ReserveSet menu details
JPY 10,000JPY6,999（Price including tax）per person

Most popular

Omakase Premium Nigiri Course21 items

Experience an elevated omakase course that includes appetizers, exquisite dishes, and nine pieces of sashimi and nigiri. Each plate showcases seasonal flavors and the essence of our carefully selected ingredients, allowing you to fully appreciate the charm of our restaurant. This luxurious offering, which even includes dessert, is perfect for anniversaries and special occasions. Enjoy a refined moment in a tranquil setting.

ReserveSet menu details
JPY 12,000JPY8,999（Price including tax）per person

Only Lunch Nigiri Gozen13 items

Indulge in our lunch-exclusive Omakase sushi course, featuring the day's recommended ingredients. This carefully crafted menu showcases the artisan's meticulous skill in sushi, complemented by a balanced selection of rolls, warm dishes, tamagoyaki, and soup. It's a satisfying yet accessible experience, making it perfect for first-time visitors. Enjoy a luxurious midday moment at Sushi Ginza!

ReserveSet menu details
JPY 6,000JPY4,999（Price including tax）per person

Omakase Nigiri Course18 items

Our standard omakase course is available for both lunch and dinner. It begins with seasonal appetizers, followed by eight carefully crafted sushi pieces, rice bowls, rolls, and soup, all designed to enhance your dining experience. We strive to provide satisfaction that exceeds the price, with a focus on each individual dish. This course is also recommended for meals with friends or small gatherings.

Each plate showcases seasonal flavors and the essence of our carefully selected ingredients, allowing you to fully appreciate the charm of our restaurant. This luxurious offering, which even includes dessert, is perfect for anniversaries and special occasions. Enjoy a refined moment in a tranquil setting.

listedCourseDetails: Only Lunch Nigiri Gozen — JPY 4,999 （Price including tax）per person. Indulge in our lunch-exclusive Omakase sushi course, featuring the day's recommended ingredients. This carefully crafted menu showcases the artisan's meticulous skill in sushi, complemented by a balanced selection of rolls, warm dishes, tamagoyaki, and soup. It's a satisfying yet accessible experience, making it perfect for first-time visitors. Enjoy a luxurious midday moment at Sushi Ginza!

Omakase Nigiri Course — JPY 6,999 （Price including tax）per person. Our standard omakase course is available for both lunch and dinner. It begins with seasonal appetizers, followed by eight carefully crafted sushi pieces, rice bowls, rolls, and soup, all designed to enhance your dining experience. We strive to provide satisfaction that exceeds the price, with a focus on each individual dish. This course is also recommended for meals with friends or small gatherings.

Omakase Premium Nigiri Course — JPY 8,999 （Price including tax）per person. Experience an elevated omakase course that includes appetizers, exquisite dishes, and nine pieces of sashimi and nigiri. Each plate showcases seasonal flavors and the essence of our carefully selected ingredients, allowing you to fully appreciate the charm of our restaurant. This luxurious offering, which even includes dessert, is perfect for anniversaries and special occasions. Enjoy a refined moment in a tranquil setting.

Seafood Buffet Dining Ginza Happo’s highlights include sushi prepared by chefs right before you and a variety of freshly cooked, piping-hot dishes. In the vibrant live kitchen, chefs present a meticulously prepared buffet that is sure to delight all five senses. The refined space, harmonizing Japanese and Western elements, provides the perfect setting for your important moments.

Premium with Jumbo Lobster & Finest Uni — Over 150 Seafood, Yakiniku & Japanese/Western/Chinese Buffet + All You Can Drink Alcohol — JPY 18,000 （Price including tax）per person; Number of people 2 - 99. <Premium Luxury Buffet & 120-minute All-You-Can-Drink Included> Indulge in our ultimate premium course featuring an extra-large lobster and the finest uni. Relax in a refined setting and enjoy this blissful experience accompanied by fine drinks.

Highlights at Seafood Buffet Dining Ginza Happo include sushi crafted by chefs right before your eyes and a wide variety of freshly prepared, piping-hot dishes.
